exact.指针扫过空格。: The hand passed an empty cell.
exact.整环顺时针转一格，然后指针前进。: Turn the whole ring clockwise, then the hand advances.
exact.整环逆时针转一格，然后指针前进。: Turn the whole ring back, then the hand advances.
exact.和环上对面的一格交换，然后指针前进。: Swap with the opposite cell, then the hand advances.
exact.先转环，指针再吃下一格。敌该送到指针前面，珠和你自己不该送。: Turn the ring first. Then the hand eats the next cell. Feed it foes, not gems or yourself.
exact.对换能把你从指针前面挪走，也会把对面的东西换过来。: A swap pulls you off the hand's path and also pulls the opposite cell over.
exact.把本局指针从哪一格开始、珠是不是被吃掉写进你自己的 memory。只把这些当作这: Write where the hand started, and whether a gem was eaten, into your own memory. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.
